author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Doing is NOT learning.

Before AI, you don't learn anything if you just blindly follow the instruction given to you without your own thinking.

After AI, you don't learn anything if you just blindly accept the slop generated by AI without your own thinking

AI only remove the doing part, AI doesn't remove the learning part. You still have to learn.
